manifest.name: dsh-chat-search
manifest.description: Ctrl+F search inside the open conversation: in-text highlights, previous/next, a match list and a count that climbs as the scan goes. Nothing is expanded and the reading position stays put.
manifest.author: P-PPJ

readme.text:
**DeepSeek Harness 的对话内搜索插件。** 按 `Ctrl+F` 就能在当前对话里查找关键词：正文高亮、上一个/下一个、命中位置列表，计数边搜边涨——而且**不展开任何折叠块，不改变你正在看的位置**。

[English](README.en.md) ｜ 简体中文

<sub>图为插件面板的界面预览（用插件自己的样式表渲染），不含任何真实对话内容。</sub>

Harness 本身没有对话内查找，`Ctrl+F` 交给浏览器后什么也不会发生；插件市场里的同类插件装上却用不了，因为它定位聊天内容靠的是 `data-chat-anchor-key`、`data-chat-node-key`、`data-chat-turn` 这类属性——**这些属性在 0.2.x 的会话视图里已经不存在了**（现在只有 `data-conversation-region`、`data-conversation-scroll`、`data-conversation-session`）。锚点找不到，跳转就永远是空的。

这个插件按现在的 DOM 契约重写，顺手把「搜索时的打扰感」也一起去掉了：

| | 浏览器原生查找 | 老插件 | 本插件 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 只在对话里搜（不含输入框/侧栏） | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| 正文高亮 | ❌ | 只闪整条消息 | ✅ 按字符高亮 |
| 上一个 / 下一个 | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| **不展开折叠块、不移动阅读位置** | — | ❌ 会展开全部 | ✅ |
| 计数随扫描实时增长 | — | ❌ 一次性阻塞 | ✅ |
| 首个命中就在你附近 | — | ❌ 从对话最顶上开始 | ✅ |
| 中文输入法合成时不误搜 | — | ❌ | ✅ |
| 点击面板外不关闭 | — | ❌ 点就关 | ✅ |

- **`Ctrl+F` 随时唤起**——包括光标停在输入框里的时候（不再弹浏览器原生查找栏）；已经打开时再按一次 = 聚焦并全选。
- **边搜边涨的计数**：扫描分片进行（每帧约 900 个节点 / 8ms），长对话也不会把界面卡住，数字一路往上走。
- **正文高亮**：用 CSS Custom Highlight API 画 Range，不往 React 的 DOM 里插 `<mark>`，所以不会触发重排、不会和宿主抢节点。
- **上一个 / 下一个**：`Enter` / `Shift+Enter`，到尽头自动回绕。
- **首个命中 = 离你最近的那处**：以当前视口顶部为锚，从近到远找第一个匹配，只有不可见时才滚动，且只滚到"刚好看得见"。
- **命中位置列表**：点击计数展开全部命中（最多 300 条），每条带片段，命中词标蓝，点哪条跳哪条。
- **回到搜索前的位置**：跳走之后点 `⟲`，一键回到开始搜索时的阅读位置（锚的是元素而不是滚动像素，所以中途加载历史也不会偏）。
- **不打扰**：不展开折叠块、不改动对话内容；点面板空白处、点聊天区都不会关；`Esc` 才关，并且把焦点还给打开前的元素。
- **顺手补历史**：开头会按需加载更早的消息（最多 80 页 / 12 秒），加载不完会在面板里说明"只搜索了已加载的部分"。
- **跟随主题**：只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token，明暗主题自动适配。

| 按键 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `Ctrl+F` / `Cmd+F` | 打开搜索；已打开则聚焦并全选 |
| `Enter` / `↓` 按钮 | 下一个命中 |
| `Shift+Enter` / `↑` 按钮 | 上一个命中 |
| `Esc` | 退出搜索，焦点还回原处 |
| 点击 `3/58` | 展开 / 收起命中位置列表 |

> 需要 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版（0.2.x）。装完**刷新页面**即可生效，不用重启应用。

**方式 A：插件安装器（推荐 `.tgz` 直链或本地文件——不需要 Git）**

> 对话框里的「安装源：中国大陆镜像源」**只改写 npm 包名的请求**。填 GitHub 地址或 `.tgz` 直链时它不参与，必须本机自己连得上。

不需要 Git 的三种填法，挑一条通得过的即可：

```
https://github.com/P-PPJ/dsh-chat-search/releases/download/v1.0.1/dsh-chat-search-1.0.1.tgz
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/P-PPJ/dsh-chat-search@main/dist/dsh-chat-search-1.0.1.tgz
D:\某个目录\dsh-chat-search-1.0.1.tgz        ← 本地文件，连网络都不用
```

**填仓库地址（`https://github.com/owner/repo`）则需要本机装过 Git。** 安装器会把这种地址当 git 依赖，用 `git ls-remote` 去解析；Windows 不自带 Git，没装就必然报这一条：

```
[ERR_PNPM_GIT_RESOLVE_FAILED] Failed to resolve git dependency "https://github.com/...":
git ls-remote failed: 'git' 不是内部或外部命令，也不是可运行的程序或批处理文件。
```

看到这句，要么把地址换成上面的 `.tgz`，要么先装 Git for Windows（`winget install Git.Git`）再重试。**这条报错和网络无关，和仓库里放了什么也无关。**

| 报错 | 真正原因 | 怎么办 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `'git' 不是内部或外部命令` / `ERR_PNPM_GIT_RESOLVE_FAILED` | 填了仓库地址，但本机没有 Git | 改用 `.tgz` 直链或本地文件；或装 Git |
| `无法连接 github.com` / `ETIMEDOUT` / `ECONNRESET` | 本机到 GitHub 的线路不通或不稳 | 见下方「中国大陆网络下载不动 `.tgz`」：套加速前缀，或交给本地文件 |
| 卡在 `allowBuilds` 提示 | 某个依赖带安装脚本，被 pnpm 拦下 | 本插件零依赖、零安装脚本，不会出现 |

> ⚠️ **中国大陆无代理实测**：GitHub Release 直链 20 秒后连接被重置（会重定向到 `objects.githubusercontent.com`）；`cdn.jsdelivr.net` 时通时断——同一条链接有时 1 秒下载完，也可能 25 秒超时。安装器对 GitHub 地址和 `.tgz` 直链**不走任何镜像源**，所以这两条在国内并不算稳，报错文案是「无法连接 github.com……需要本机能直接访问它或配置代理」。
>
> 四种装法（Release tarball、`git+` 地址、`github:` 简写、CDN tarball）都用 Harness 自带的 pnpm 11 实测过：能连上时 `exit=0`、装出来版本 1.0.1 —— **包本身没有问题：失败要么是本机没有 Git，要么是线路不通，两者都在本机一侧**。

readme.section: 中国大陆网络下载不动 `.tgz` 怎么办
readme.text:
Release 直链会 302 到 `objects.githubusercontent.com`，国内常见 `ECONNRESET`。可以给地址套一个加速前缀——规则就是「**镜像前缀 + 完整 GitHub 地址**」，装的是同一份字节（sha256 `51af9c1c…`）：

```
https://ghfast.top/https://github.com/P-PPJ/dsh-chat-search/releases/download/v1.0.1/dsh-chat-search-1.0.1.tgz
https://gh-proxy.com/https://github.com/P-PPJ/dsh-chat-search/releases/download/v1.0.1/dsh-chat-search-1.0.1.tgz
https://ghproxy.net/https://github.com/P-PPJ/dsh-chat-search/releases/download/v1.0.1/dsh-chat-search-1.0.1.tgz
```

readme.section: 中国大陆网络下载不动 `.tgz` 怎么办
readme.text:
实测（无代理）：`ghfast.top` 4.0 秒、`gh-proxy.com` 4.2 秒、`ghproxy.net` 9.6 秒；用第一条地址跑 `pnpm add` 4.6 秒装出 1.0.1，文件校验和与官方一致。

> 这些是**第三方公共镜像**，可用性不由本项目保证；嫌麻烦就把 `.tgz` 下载下来，改用本地路径装（完全不联网）。

**方式 C：Release 预构建包（插件市场装的就是这个）**

readme.section: 中国大陆网络下载不动 `.tgz` 怎么办
readme.text: > **已收录进社区目录**：`插件 → 市场` 里搜 `dsh-chat-search` 就能找到（条目是 `awesome-dsh-plugin` 的 [PR #10155](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/10155)，账号改名为 `P-PPJ` 后由 [PR #11623](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/11623) 更新地址）。目录只收精选条目，所以本仓库按它的要求整理过：`package.json` 里有 `dsh.bundle`、根目录有 `screenshots.json`、`assets/` 下是位图图标、Release 上有预构建 tarball。

readme.section: 中国大陆网络下载不动 `.tgz` 怎么办
readme.text: > ⚠️ **与同名旧插件冲突**：社区里另一个也叫 `dsh-chat-search` 的包（`helo060228/dsh-chat-search`）用的是同一个包名。装本插件前请先把旧的那条依赖和 bundle 删掉，否则 npm 会直接覆盖，且两个 bundle 会在同一个 overlay 槽里抢 `Ctrl+F`。

1. **找到对话**：`[data-conversation-region="chat"]` 就是聊天区，滚动容器是 `[data-conversation-scroll]`；`[data-conversation-region="composer"]`（输入框那一块在 chat region 里面）整个剪掉，所以搜不到自己正在写的字。
2. **把文本拼成块**：手写一个走树的 walker，把文本节点按"最近的非行内祖先"分组拼成字符串——所以短语即使跨了 `<code>`、`<span>`、加粗，也能整句命中；`script/style/svg/hidden` 一律跳过。
3. **分片扫描**：walker 每帧只走约 900 个节点或 8ms，匹配结果攒够一批再交给界面，计数因此是"涨"出来的而不是等出来的。
4. **高亮**：每个命中造一个 `Range`，丢进 `CSS.highlights`（全部命中一个集合、当前命中另一个集合，优先级更高），配色写在组件内的 `<style>` 里。
5. **定位**：用 `elementFromPoint` 取视口顶部那块节点当锚，`compareDocumentPosition` 找到第一个"在锚之后"的命中；滚动时由外到内逐个滚动容器校正，只做最小位移。
6. **输入法**：`compositionstart/end` + `isComposing` + `keyCode 229` 三重判断，合成期间不搜索、不响应 `Enter`/`Esc`，落字之后才搜一次。

- **折叠块里的文字搜不到**：Tool 调用、思考过程、被折叠的长输出都是条件渲染，内容根本不在 DOM 里。想要搜到它们只能先点开——而这正好会改变你的阅读位置，与"无痕"冲突，所以不做。需要的话可以后续加一个默认关闭的「包含折叠内容」开关。
- **命中上限 3000**、染色上限 1200、位置列表 300 条（再多也没有意义，读不过来）。
- **更早的历史**最多补 80 页 / 12 秒，超出会显示"只搜索了已加载的部分"。
- **需要 CSS Custom Highlight API**（Chromium 105+，Harness 桌面版满足）；不支持时仍能定位跳转，只是不染色。
- **绑定宿主 DOM 契约**：依赖 `data-conversation-*` 这几个属性。Harness 大版本改了结构就需要更新插件（这也是老插件坏掉的原因）。

readme.section: 想发布自己的 DSH 插件？
readme.text:
仓库根目录还有一份技能 [`publishing-dsh-plugin/`](publishing-dsh-plugin/SKILL.md)——把这个插件从「本地能跑」推到「别人贴个地址就能装」的完整过程：打包、推 GitHub、写 README、进社区目录，以及对方装不上时怎么一条条查下去。

放进 `~/.dsh/skills/`（Windows 是 `C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\skills\`），新开一个会话就能用：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/P-PPJ/dsh-chat-search.git
Copy-Item .\dsh-chat-search\publishing-dsh-plugin "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\" -Recurse
```

readme.section: 想发布自己的 DSH 插件？
readme.text:
| 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `SKILL.md` | 六道关卡：注册 → 打包 → GitHub → README → 目录 → 安装链路，附交付前检查清单 |
| `references/readme-template.md` | 可直接套用的 README 骨架 |
| `references/registry-entry.md` | 目录条目字段、分类枚举、纯 API 提 PR、改名后的迁移 |
| `references/install-troubleshooting.md` | 报错原文 → 真因 → 解法（含实测数字） |

```
client.js         # 全部功能：扫描、高亮、面板（React 组件 + CSS）
index.js          # Host 半，空实现（本插件纯前端）
cordis.patch.yml  # 把 bundle 插进 profile
locale/zh.json    # 插件信息（名称/简介）

没有构建步骤、没有第三方依赖：`client.js` 是一个 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({...})` 的工厂函数，React 从宿主模块表里 `require('react')` 拿。

- 改 `client.js` 后刷新页面就生效（插件以 `file:` 链接进 profile 时不需要重装）。
- `node --check client.js` 做语法检查。
- 插件通过 `ctx.slots.register({ name: 'shell.overlay', id: 'dsh-chat-search', order: 60 }, FindOverlay)` 挂到全屏浮层槽位，浮层本身 click-through，只有面板自己接收鼠标事件。

**Find-in-conversation for DeepSeek Harness.** `Ctrl+F` searches the conversation you are reading: in-text highlights, previous/next, a match list, and a count that climbs while the scan runs — **without opening a single collapsed block or moving your reading position.**

English ｜ [简体中文](README.md)

<sub>Interface previews, rendered with the plugin's own stylesheet; they contain no conversation content.</sub>

Harness has no find-in-conversation of its own, so `Ctrl+F` falls through to the browser and does nothing useful. The plugin in the marketplace does not work either: it locates messages through `data-chat-anchor-key`, `data-chat-node-key` and `data-chat-turn`, and **none of those attributes exist in the 0.2.x conversation view any more** (there is only `data-conversation-region`, `data-conversation-scroll` and `data-conversation-session`). With no anchors, every jump resolves to nothing.
This plugin is written against the current DOM contract, and drops the interruption that search usually brings with it:

| | Browser find | The old plugin | This plugin |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Only inside the conversation (not the composer or the sidebar) | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Highlights | ❌ | flashes the whole message | ✅ per character |
| Previous / next | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| **Opens no collapsed block, moves nothing** | — | ❌ expands everything | ✅ |
| Count grows while scanning | — | ❌ one blocking pass | ✅ |
| First hit is the one near you | — | ❌ always from the top | ✅ |
| IME composition is not searched | — | ❌ | ✅ |
| Clicking outside keeps the panel | — | ❌ closes on click | ✅ |

- **`Ctrl+F` anywhere** — including while the caret is in an input (no browser find bar); pressing it again focuses and selects the field.
- **A count that climbs**: the scan is sliced (≈900 nodes / 8ms per frame), so a long conversation stays responsive and the number keeps rising instead of blocking.
- **Real text highlights** via the CSS Custom Highlight API — ranges only, nothing inserted into React's DOM, no reflow.
- **Previous / next** with `Enter` / `Shift+Enter`, wrapping at the ends.
- **The first hit is the one nearest to you**: the current viewport top is the anchor, the nearest at-or-after match wins, and it is scrolled only as far as it must be (not at all when already visible).
- **Match list**: click the counter to open every hit (up to 300), each with its snippet; click a row to jump.
- **Back to where you were**: after a jump, `⟲` returns to the reading position you had when you opened the panel (anchored to an element, so paging in history does not throw it off).
- **Non-invasive**: no collapsed block is opened, the conversation is never mutated; clicking the panel background or the chat area does not close it; `Esc` closes and returns focus to where it was.
- **

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Ctrl+F` / `Cmd+F` | Open; when already open, focus and select |
| `Enter` / `↓` button | Next match |
| `Shift+Enter` / `↑` button | Previous match |
| `Esc` | Close and restore focus |
| Click `3/58` | Toggle the match list |

> DeepSeek Harness desktop, 0.2.x. Refresh the page afterwards — no restart needed.

**A. Through the plugin installer (prefer a `.tgz` link or a local file — no Git required)**

> The dialog's "mainland China mirror" source only rewrites requests for an **npm package name**. A GitHub address or a `.tgz` link bypasses it and must be reachable from the machine itself.

Three ways that do **not** need Git — pick one whose host you can reach:

```
https://github.com/P-PPJ/dsh-chat-search/releases/download/v1.0.1/dsh-chat-search-1.0.1.tgz
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/P-PPJ/dsh-chat-search@main/dist/dsh-chat-search-1.0.1.tgz
D:\some\dir\dsh-chat-search-1.0.1.tgz        ← a local file: no network at all
```

**Pasting the repository address (`https://github.com/owner/repo`) requires Git on the machine.** The installer treats such an address as a git dependency and resolves it with `git ls-remote`; Windows does not ship Git, so without it you inevitably get:

```
[ERR_PNPM_GIT_RESOLVE_FAILED] Failed to resolve git dependency "https://github.com/...":
git ls-remote failed: 'git' is not recognized as an internal or external command,
operable program or batch file.
```

Seeing that, either switch to one of the `.tgz` addresses above, or install Git for Windows (`winget install Git.Git`) and retry. **That error has nothing to do with the network, and nothing to do with what is in the repository.**

| Error | Real cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `'git' is not recognized…` / `ERR_PNPM_GIT_RESOLVE_FAILED` | Repository address pasted, but no Git installed | Use a `.tgz` link or local file, or install Git |
| `Could not connect to github.com` / `ETIMEDOUT` / `ECONNRESET` | No working route from this machine to GitHub | See "When the `.tgz` will not download": prefix an accelerator, or hand it a local file |
| Stuck on an `allowBuilds` prompt | A dependency has an install script pnpm blocked | This plugin has no dependencies and no install scripts — cannot happen |

> ⚠️ **Measured from mainland China without a proxy**: a GitHub release link is reset after ~20s (it redirects to `objects.githubusercontent.com`), and `cdn.jsdelivr.net` is intermittent — the same URL sometimes downloads in 1s and sometimes times out at 25s. The installer fetches GitHub addresses and `.tgz` links **directly, not through any mirror**, so neither is dependable there; the error it shows is "could not connect to github.com … this machine must reach it directly or through a proxy".
>
> All four forms (release tarball, `git+` address, `github:` shorthand, CDN tarball) were tested with the pnpm 11 that ships inside Harness: `exit=0` and version 1.0.1 whenever the network cooperates — **the package itself is fine: a failure means either Git is missing on the machine or the route is down — both are local conditions.**

readme.text:
Measured without a proxy: `ghfast.top` 4.0s, `gh-proxy.com` 4.2s, `ghproxy.net` 9.6s; `pnpm add` with the first one installed 1.0.1 in 4.6s and the checksum matched the official asset.

**B. Straight into a profile**

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/P-PPJ/dsh-chat-search.git
```

readme.section: When the `.tgz` will not download (mainland China)
When the `.tgz` will not download (mainland China)

readme.section: When the `.tgz` will not download (mainland China)
readme.text: > **Listed in the community registry**: search `dsh-chat-search` under **Plugins → Market** ([PR #10155](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/10155), with the address updated by [PR #11623](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/11623) after the account was renamed to `P-PPJ`). That registry only takes curated entries, so this repo meets its requirements: `dsh.bundle` in `package.json`, `screenshots.json` at the root, raster icons under `assets/`, and a prebuilt tarball on the release.

readme.section: When the `.tgz` will not download (mainland China)
readme.text: > ⚠️ **Name clash**: the community plugin `helo060228/dsh-chat-search` uses the same package name. Remove that dependency and bundle entry first — npm would otherwise overwrite one with the other, and both bundles would fight over `Ctrl+F` in the same overlay slot.

1. **Find the conversation**: `[data-conversation-region="chat"]` is the chat area; `[data-conversation-scroll]` is the scroller. `[data-conversation-region="composer"]` sits *inside* the chat region, so it is pruned entirely — what you are typing is never searched.
2. **Build text blocks**: a hand-written tree walker groups text nodes by their nearest non-inline ancestor into strings, so a phrase still matches when it spans `<code>`, `<span>` or bold text; `script/style/svg/hidden` is skipped.
3. **Slice the scan**: ~900 nodes or 8ms per frame, with results published in batches — that is why the count rises rather than appearing all at once.
4. **Paint**: one `Range` per match into `CSS.highlights` (all matches in one registry, the current match in a second one with higher priority); colours live in the component's own `<style>`.
5. **Navigate**: `elementFromPoint` gives the block at the viewport top, `compareDocumentPosition` picks the first match at or after it, and scrolling corrects each scroll container from the outside in, moving as little as possible.
6. **IME**: `compositionstart/end` + `isComposing` + `keyCode 229`. Nothing is searched and no key is handled while a compos

- **Text inside collapsed blocks cannot be found**: tool calls, reasoning and folded output are conditional renders, so their content is not in the DOM at all. Reaching it would mean opening blocks — exactly the thing that throws off your reading position — so the plugin does not. A default-off "include collapsed content" switch is the possible follow-up.
- **3000 matches** counted, 1200 painted, 300 rows listed.
- **Earlier history** is paged in for at most 80 pages / 12s; past that the panel says only the loaded part was searched.
- **Needs the CSS Custom Highlight API** (Chromium 105+; the desktop app has it). Without it navigation still works, just without colour.
- **Bound to the host DOM contract** (`data-conversation-*`). A major Harness layout change needs an update here — the same reason the old plugin stopped working.

The repository root also carries a skill, [`publishing-dsh-plugin/`](publishing-dsh-plugin/SKILL.md): the whole path from "it works on my machine" to "someone else pastes a link and it installs" — packaging the bundle, pushing to GitHub, writing the README, getting into the community registry, and diagnosing an install that fails on the other side.

Drop it into `~/.dsh/skills/` (`C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\skills\` on Windows) and it is available in the next session:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/P-PPJ/dsh-chat-search.git
Copy-Item .\dsh-chat-search\publishing-dsh-plugin "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\" -Recurse
```

| File | Covers |
| --- | --- |
| `SKILL.md` | Six gates: register → package → GitHub → README → registry → install chain, plus a pre-release checklist |
| `references/readme-template.md` | A README skeleton you can fill in |
| `references/registry-entry.md` | Registry entry fields, category enum, opening the PR through the API, renaming later |
| `references/install-troubleshooting.md` | Error text → real cause → fix, with measured numbers |

```
client.js         # everything: walker, scan, highlights, panel (React + CSS)
index.js          # host half, empty (this plugin is client-only)
cordis.patch.yml  # inserts the bundle into a profile
locale/zh.json    # plugin metadata (title, description)

No build step and no dependencies: `client.js` is one `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({...})` factory that takes React from the host's module table.

- Edit `client.js` and refresh the page (a `file:` linked plugin needs no reinstall).
- `node --check client.js` for syntax.
- The panel is registered with `ctx.slots.register({ name: 'shell.overlay', id: 'dsh-chat-search', order: 60 }, FindOverlay)`; the overlay layer is click-through, only the panel takes pointer events.
